awd.label: Select, Premium, GT, Rally
awd.note: 'The Mustang Mach-E offers three drivetrain options: RWD, eAWD, and the GT enhanced eAWD.' eAWD available on Select and Premium; GT enhanced eAWD. C/D 2026 trims: Select RWD/AWD, Premium RWD/AWD, GT AWD. Rally appears in Ford's spec table; EPA lists the 2026 Mustang Mach-E Rally as All-Wheel Drive (https://www.fueleconomy.gov/ws/rest/vehicle/50203).

adapter.note: Ford, Feb. 29, 2024: 'Ford F-150 Lightning and Mustang Mach-E retail customers are the first of any non-Tesla automaker to gain access to Tesla Superchargers across the U.S. and Canada.' Ford support (https://www.ford.com/support/how-tos/electric-vehicles/public-charging/how-do-i-get-a-fast-charging-adapter-nacs/): the Fast Charging Adapter is 'available on the Ford Accessories website' and 'unlocks charging at ... thousands of Tesla Superchargers'.

charge_port.note: Ford.com's 2026 Mach-E page doesn't name the connector; CCS1 inferred from Ford's support page: 'Due to the difference between the NACS plug design and the charge port on your electric vehicle, adapters are required to use NACS chargers'.
